title: MatMMExtract: An Open-Source Pipeline for Panel-Level Extraction of Grounded Image-Text Pairs from Materials Science Literature
abstract: arXiv:2606.29667v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The materials science literature encodes decades of experimental knowledge in figures, yet this visual record remains locked away and inaccessible to AI at scale. The core difficulty is structural: most scientific figures are compound, with a single caption describing multiple sub-panels simultaneously, making direct image-text pairing unreliable. We present MatMMExtract, an end-to-end open-source pipeline that resolves this by decomposing compound figures into individual sub-panels and generating structured, grounded annotations using a large language model guided by a curated materials science taxonomy. Applied to 14,810 open-access articles, MatMMExtract produces MatSciFig; 391,606 panel-level image-text pairs from 180,571 figures, each annotated with a sub-caption, a two-level visualisation category spanning 19 classes and over 100 subtypes, and a scientific summary. translated_title: MatMMExtract：一个用于从材料科学文献中提取面板级图文对的开源流水线
translated_abstract: 材料科学文献以图表形式编码了几十年的实验知识，然而这一视觉记录仍然被锁定，无法供人工智能大规模访问。核心困难在于结构性的：大多数科学图表是复合型的，单个标题同时描述多个子面板，使得直接的图文配对不可靠。我们提出了MatMMExtract，一个端到端的开源流水线，通过将复合图表分解为单个子面板，并使用由精选材料科学分类法引导的大语言模型生成结构化的、有依据的标注来解决这一问题。应用于14,810篇开放获取文章，MatMMExtract生成了MatSciFig；从180,571个图表中产生391,606个面板级图文对，每个都标注有子标题、涵盖19个类别和100多个子类型的两级可视化分类，以及科学摘要。为了实现准确的面板定位，我们引入了Mater...
tldr: 本文提出了一个开源流水线MatMMExtract，能自动将材料科学文献中的复合图表分解为单个子面板并生成有依据的图文标注，从而大规模解锁图表中的实验知识。
en_tdlr: This paper presents MatMMExtract, an open-source pipeline that automatically decomposes compound figures in materials science literature into sub-panels and generates grounded image-text annotations, unlocking experimental knowledge at scale.
